keep.text: Export and import both move rows in batches of `settings.BATCH_SIZE` (5,000 rows)
A transfer always ends with an empty batch

readme_rule.why: follows the out-of-date README and settings.py: one BATCH_SIZE of 5,000 for both, and an empty batch at the end

swapped_sizes.why: swaps the two sizes: export in 2,750s, import in 7,500s

one_setting.why: keeps one shared setting, set to 2,750 to suit both, so export's batches are too small

empty_end.why: gets the sizes right but still ends each transfer with the README's empty batch

exact_multiple.why: stops at the first short batch, so a transfer of an exact multiple, or of nothing, ends with an empty one
